name: Wheel Weight
description: Lay the weight of the wheel on a foe so that all their harms drag at once on their qi.

name: Karmic Lance
description: Hurl a lance made of the foe's own deeds through the guard and the body behind it.

name: Merit Aegis
description: Stand a bastion built from stored merit that holds against any blow of lesser weight.

name: Fruit Mending
description: Mend the wounds of an ally with the fruit of the user's good deeds and cleanse their taint.

name: Wheel Mirror
description: Turn the wheel into a mirror that gives every harm back in the form it came.

name: Wheel Return
description: Return all that has been done to the user in full measure and past every guard.

name: Sin Seal
description: Seal a foe's power under the weight of their gravest wrong until it is answered.

name: Boon Revival
description: Spend a lifetime of merit to bring back one whose breath has just stopped; it never returns the long dead.

name: Wheel Verdict
description: Pass the school's verdict on every foe in the field and strike and weigh down each by as much as the reserve gives.

name: Wheel Mercy
description: Grant the school's mercy to the allies and mend and strengthen each by as much as the reserve gives.

name: Lives Reckoned
description: Reckon every wrong in the field at once and strike each foe down to the ceiling of a Core cultivator's destruction.

name: Wheel Unbroken
description: Settle the whole debt of every deed a being has ever done across all its lives in one instant; no cultivation energy mechanic explains the reach.

name: Divine Tally
description: Hold a divine tally of every deed in sight and read each person's whole account at once.

name: Heavy Karma
description: Drop the full weight of a foe's karma on their qi until every motion is a labour.

name: Karmic Ward
description: Raise a divine ward that holds firm against every blow whose cause the user has not earned.

name: Grace Pour
description: Pour stored grace into an ally and close wounds that would otherwise take many days.

name: Divine Return
description: Return a harm in divine measure past every guard to the one who first set it moving.

name: Karma Seal
description: Seal a foe's whole working of divine energy beneath the debts they have not paid.

name: Divine Absolution
description: Absolve an ally of a great curse or binding by taking its weight into the divine account.

name: Karmic Phase
description: Pass out of the line of cause so that a blow has no path by which to reach the user.

name: Divine Ledger
description: Open the school's divine ledger over the field and bind and strike each debtor by as much as the reserve gives.

name: Divine Grace
description: Pour the school's grace on the allies and mend and strengthen each by as much as the reserve gives.

name: World Reckoning
description: Call the account of a whole battlefield due at once; the scale is the destructive ceiling of a Divine cultivator.

name: First Cause
description: Trace the first cause of a being's existence and answer it in full; the reach goes before any act and no cultivation energy mechanic explains it.
